intro: Freya chair makes dining moments feel effortless. With plush cushioning, supportive curves, and a sturdy base with optional swivel, it adapts to your mood, steady or free-moving comfort.

features.title: Plush cushioning that welcomes you
features.text: The padded seat and backrest relieve pressure, giving you lasting comfort through family meals, late-night work sessions, or coffee catch-ups.

features.title: Curved backrest for natural posture
features.text: Designed to follow the shape of your spine, it keeps you comfortably upright, reducing strain during long conversations at the table.

features.title: Diverse leg base options to suit your needs
features.text: Choose fixed legs for firm stability or swivel for flexible motion. This adaptability makes your chair ready for every kind of dining setup.

features.title: Toffee shade that warms every space
features.text: The deep brown finish adds cozy sophistication, making your dining room feel inviting while pairing well with both wood and neutral tones.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading
